title: sisymbrium ochroleucum
intro: Sisymbrium ochroleucum, commonly known as yellow rocket, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of yellow rocket are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Sisymbrium ochroleucum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
